page: OVHcloud c3-256-flex is a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an AMD EPYC processor based on the x86_64 architecture, providing 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs clocked at 2.3 GHz with a 1:1 core-to-thread allocation. The CPU incorporates 32 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, with hardware instruction support for AVX, AES-NI, SHA-NI, and BMI2. The instance is provisioned with 256.0 GB of total RAM, corresponding to 2.0 GB of memory per core, and includes 50 GB of local NVMe SSD storage alongside a 20 Gbps baseline network interface. It does not include discrete GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations show exceptional parallel execution capabilities, driven by the massive 128 dedicated core count. In multi-core stress testing with stress-ng, the instance achieves a top-tier score of 288,873.76, complemented by strong single-core performance of 3,078.19. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression yields 1,160.14 GB/sec, placing it in the top decile. In-memory throughput is demonstrated by 162.2 million Redis SET operations per second and cached memory bandwidth of 10,902.15 GB/sec. Uncached large-block read and write bandwidths measure 116.35 GB/sec and 42.41 GB/sec respectively, reflecting average sustained main memory bandwidth. Static web serving throughput reaches 52.53 GB/sec, while LLM inference prompt processing reaches 3,925.03 tokens per second on a small 135M model and 210.85 tokens per second on a 7B model.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio offers dense compute power without the overhead of surplus RAM allocations, creating a resource profile suitable for parallel CPU execution. Tradeoffs include the absence of AVX-512 vector extensions and modest root storage capacity of 50 GB NVMe, necessitating external storage volumes for large datasets. OVHcloud c3-256-flex is well matched for highly parallel CPU tasks, batch compression, Redis cache clusters, web serving fleets, and CI/CD build farms.
description: OVHcloud c3-256-flex is a compute-optimized cloud instance powered by a dedicated 128-core AMD EPYC x86_64 processor clocked at 2.3 GHz without hyperthreading. It features 256.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per core), 50 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and a 20 Gbps baseline network connection. In multi-core synthetic benchmarks, the instance demonstrates top-tier parallel throughput, highlighted by 288,873.76 in stress-ng multi-core tests, 1,160.14 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and 162.2 million Redis SET operations per second. While uncached large-block memory bandwidth is within average ranges and local NVMe capacity is compact, the dedicated non-hyperthreaded core layout maximizes multi-threaded efficiency. This makes the instance suitable for distributed build systems, large-scale batch processing, web serving architectures, and CPU-based inference workloads.
